mentions.name: root-dir
mentions.description: A command-line community featuring public profiles and an IRC-style chat. It requires at least basic command-line knowledge to use, and is currently in closed beta with new batches of invites sent out frequently.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on https://www.root-dir.com - a command-line community with public profiles and an IRC style chat.

You can't use this without having at least basic knowledge of the command-line.

Currently in closed beta, but sending out new batches of invites frequently.
